description.title: Description
description.remarks: The description of this standard action.

type.title: Type
type.remarks: The type of standard action. Valid values are in the PLUSGSTDACTIONTYPE domain.

hasscore.title: Score
hasscore.remarks: Indicates whether the item that is reviewed requires a score type of response.

hasitems.title: Review Action
hasitems.remarks: Indicates whether action is a review.

reviewtype.title: Review Response Type
reviewtype.remarks: The type of response that is required for the item that is reviewed, such as Yes or No, or a numeric response. An item can also have a combined type of response.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site associated with this standard action.

timing.title: Timing
timing.remarks: The timing of the standard action identifies any time dependency on the action, for example, whether the action is required prior to, or after this management of change is implemented. Valid values are in the PLUSGACTIONTIMING domain.

canrepeat.title: Repeatable
canrepeat.remarks: Indicates whether a standard action can be repeated.

ischecklist.title: Checklist
ischecklist.remarks: Indicates whether the standard action is a checklist item

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization associated with this standard action.

isrevact.title: Review Action
isrevact.remarks: Indicates whether the action for the item must be reviewed.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date and time when the standard action status is set or changed by someone using the Change Status action.

stdactnum.title: Standard Action
stdactnum.remarks: The unique identifier of this standard action.

isalphanumeric.title: Alphanumeric
isalphanumeric.remarks: Indicates whether the response for the item that is reviewed requires a number, an alphabetic or alphanumeric identifier, or any of these combinations.

category.title: Category
category.remarks: The category of the action. Valid values are in the PLUSGACTIONCAT domain.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of this standard action.

yesorno.title: Yes or No
yesorno.remarks: Indicates whether the item that is reviewed requires a Yes or No answer.
